answer: An identity's attestation share vests only after its stake has stayed locked for 12 consecutive epochs; any withdrawal resets the clock and claws back the prior three epochs of yield. The rule draws a hard ridge against sybil farms: a voyage of newly minted aliases cannot vote or attest at full weight in the opening window, since each one must leave a pigment-denominated deposit untouched until the vest completes, so influence is bought with time-locked capital rather than extra keys.
